FortiGate High Availability Audit
================================================================================

─── HA Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| Mode                   | a-p                              |
| Password               | (not set)                        |
| HB Device              |                                  |
| HB Encryption          | disable                          |
| HB Interval            |                                  |
| Monitor Interfaces     |                                  |
| Config Sync            | disable                          |
| Session Pickup         |                                  |
| Mgmt Interface         |                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
Findings:
  [HIGH] HA: cluster has no password — any FortiGate can join.
  [MEDIUM] HA: heartbeat traffic not encrypted — sync data in cleartext on heartbeat interfaces.
  [MEDIUM] HA: heartbeat device not configured.
  [MEDIUM] HA: interface monitoring not configured — link failures may not trigger failover.
  [INFO] HA: config sync disabled — secondary may diverge from primary.
  [INFO] HA: session pickup disabled — active sessions dropped on failover.
  [INFO] HA: dedicated HA management interface not configured.
